Synthetic Backend Engineer Demo

Responsibilities
- Build reliable Node.js APIs for a fictional interview practice product.
- Explain engineering trade-offs and validate changes with automated tests.
- Collaborate with product and design partners.

Requirements
- Experience with JavaScript, HTTP APIs, testing, and cloud deployment.
- Clear written and spoken communication.
